data.one_liner: A widget to style and interact with parts of a text string based on predefined rules.
data.what_it_does: The DecoratedText widget allows you to style and make parts of a text string interactive using predefined rules like words, prefixes, tags, URLs, or custom regular expressions. It supports callbacks for taps on matched text and allows text selection.
use_when: You need to highlight specific words, hashtags, mentions, or links inside a block of text.
You want users to be able to tap on specific styled portions of text such as URLs or hashtags.
You need custom regular expression styling and inline widget builders within text.
avoid_when: You only need standard rich text formatting without pattern matching or interactive spans.
You are building a full markdown parser or rich text editor requiring complex syntax trees.
strengths: Comes with many built-in rules for words, prefixes, tags, and URLs.
Supports interactive tap callbacks and selectable text.
Optimized with internal RegExp caching and efficient tag deduplication.
weaknesses: Limited to rule-based pattern matching and styling rather than full markup parsing.
Complex custom regexes may require manual caching for optimal performance.
